headline.purpose: Preview H1, 26px at the 13px base; 600, -0.02em; Inter.

body.purpose: Preview prose, 14px / 1.6 desktop, 75ch measure, left aligned.

label.purpose: Labels, fields, buttons, and controls (--text-label, 13px = base); buttons 500.

list.purpose: Sidebar rows in Explorer, Search, Source Control, Walkthroughs, Feedback (--text-list, 14px Inter); file names in them are 13px mono.

supporting.purpose: Supporting UI, the search input, and tables: 14px / 20px.

metadata.purpose: Footer and metadata, 12px sans: counts, ages, stats, git status letters, kbd, toggle glyphs, the blame card's age.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono at 13px for preview code (block line-height 1.6), --text-code UI snippets, file names in lists (--text-file), and inline blame; ligatures off.

source.purpose: Source lines: JetBrains Mono 13px on fixed 22px rows (--source-line-height).

site-display.purpose: The landing h1 only (hero row); system sans, balanced.

site-heading.purpose: Each landing feature row h2; balanced.

site-chrome.purpose: JetBrains Mono: feature label (accent, lowercase), chips, tabs, bands, terminals, pane code on 22px rows.

site-status.purpose: Mono kbd, pane status bars, the install Copy action (uppercase, 0.08em).

site-label.purpose: Uppercase mono chrome names (pane side heads, note titles); never a headline eyebrow.

site-docs-section.purpose: Vocs sidebar section labels, code block band labels, and Copy, in --sz-muted.

site-docs-nav.purpose: Vocs sidebar items; outline rows use 0.75rem on 22px.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Primary and outline buttons, the raised and chip CopyButton, gutter controls, the pressed sm segment. Dark: rgb(0 0 0 / 24%); named themes override.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The one overlay surface: dialogs, the drawer, popovers, menus, and HoverCard. Dark: rgb(0 0 0 / 42%); named themes override.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: The 1px accent mark on selected rows, highlighted menu items, and pressed IconButtons; holds 3:1 over the 12% selection fill.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Fields swap their border to the focus color and add this ring; destructive when invalid.

shadows.name: status-hairline
shadows.purpose: The footer's top hairline, inset so its flush controls keep the full status height.

shadows.name: site-edge
shadows.purpose: Site only: a feature row's 2px tint top edge and the selected install tab's 2px accent edge. The site has no drop shadows.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State changes: button, row, and inline blame color; HoverCard fade; the change-mark wedge.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Progress bar opacity, navigation progress fade, walkthrough chevron and panel (with ease-out-expo).

motion.name: delay-progress
motion.purpose: Short work finishes before a progress indicator appears.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: CopyButton check or X feedback; the settings reveal flash.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Expressive easing for progress, walkthrough, and settings motion.

motion.name: hover-card-open
motion.purpose: A precise pointer resting on a HoverCard trigger opens it.

motion.name: hover-card-close
motion.purpose: Delay before a HoverCard closes after the pointer leaves trigger and card.

motion.name: duration-instant
motion.purpose: Reduced motion collapses transitions and animations.

motion.name: site-button
motion.purpose: Landing button background and border color.

breakpoints.name: fine-pointer
breakpoints.value: (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine): inactive tabs hide their close action

components.name: Inline blame and HoverCard
components.description: Inline blame (decision 0139): muted mono text 2rem after the active line, at most 60ch, truncated; hover or an open card lifts it to text-secondary. It is a HoverCard trigger (opens after a 400ms rest, closes 150ms after leaving; a click toggles it). The card is the overlay surface (strong hairline, raised fill, overlay shadow), 28rem: author 600, muted email, 12px age on the end; subject 600; body in text-secondary capped at 10rem; the short hash in amber mono with Copy Hash; ghost sm actions.

narrative.overview:
zero keeps VS Code's conventions and takes Zed's visual language (decision 0102): an activity bar, a compact explorer and search sidebar, document tabs, a readable preview, and a quiet status footer, as square panes meeting on 1px hairlines. Slate surfaces, flat rows, and restrained controls keep local files central.

Workspace identity sits above the explorer as the project picker trigger. App identity, content search, process state, and the Settings gear sit in the footer; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P opens the command palette. There is no top app header; the logo sits in the footer and on Welcome. The macOS desktop app draws only a title band under its traffic lights (decision 0119). Mobile keeps the document visible and opens files in a drawer.

The marketing landing (`/`, `apps/site/src/landing/`) and the Vocs docs chrome (`apps/site/src/pages/_root.css`) carry the same sharp slate world onto the web (decisions 0102, 0105, 0106, 0107). The landing is a column of feature rows: the hero, then browse, diffs, walkthroughs, remote, and lean, each with its copy on the left beside its own app pane on the right. Nothing here changes the app sections above; the site has no runtime theme set, only Vocs' light and dark.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere; panes meet on 1px hairlines, with no canvas gaps.
Left-aligned proportional prose and monospace code; monospace chrome labels.
Shared semantic roles across named editor themes.
Site: a framed 75rem column on 1px blue-tinted rails over a diagonal hatch.
Site: one mild tint per feature, on its row's top edge and its pane's framing.
Site: HTML-built app panes at app density, captioned "synthetic demo"; no screenshots, no SVG animation.
Site: square corners, 1px borders, mono chrome labels, system type.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent for state and interaction; keep routine prose headings and large surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Tint Follows the Feature Rule
rules.body: A feature's tint marks it everywhere at once: its row's top edge, its copy's terminal, and its pane's framing (coral remote terminal, green lean ledger). Tints are borders and edges, never fills or text.

rules.name: The Coral Reserve Rule
rules.body: Coral belongs to the logo mark and to remote (plus docs warnings and dangers). No other feature takes it.

rules.name: The Four-Sided Border Rule
rules.body: In the docs chrome a tinted element is framed on all four sides by a 1px border: code blocks take `border` on `bg`; callouts take their kind's tint with its wash (note and info blue, tip and success green, warning and danger coral). No side stripes on callouts, code, or content.

dos: Do reuse semantic CSS tokens and shared primitives across every theme.
Do retain 14px desktop / 15px mobile prose (at the 13px base), 75ch measure, and left alignment.
Do size new UI in rem so it follows the Font Size setting; reserve px for 1–2px borders and offsets.
Do keep file/path search (Explorer) separate from content search (Search view).
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible labels, modal behavior, and reduced motion.
Do keep fonts, icons, and runtime assets local to the embedded Go distribution.
Do build UI from the primitives and tokens; extend a primitive rather than restyling it in a feature.
Do keep strict TypeScript: no `any`, non-null assertions, or type assertions.
Do scope landing styles under `.landing` with `--l-*` tokens, and docs styles in `_root.css` with `--sz-*` tokens over Vocs' `data-v-*` hooks.
Do write every site color as `light-dark(light, dark)` so both Vocs themes follow its toggle.
Do give each feature one tint and repeat it on its row's top edge, its terminal, and its pane framing.
Do build demo panes in HTML and CSS from the slate tokens at app density, captioned "synthetic demo"; state facts, not benchmarks.
Do frame docs code and callouts with a full 1px tinted border.
Do keep landing type on the system sans and mono stacks.
Do grow touch controls to 44px under 900px.
donts: Don't add a top app header or logo; keep workspace identity above the explorer and app identity in the footer.
Don't restore the mobile split; use the files drawer with 32px rows/toolbar and a 44px footer.
Don't hand-roll buttons, fields, rows, or overlays; don't add color, size, or motion literals outside the token files.
Don't round a corner, or separate panes with gaps; panes meet on 1px hairlines.
Don't center preview prose or substitute generic heading/body tokens for the preview scale.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, pill containers, heavy shadows, or cards around document sections.
Don't rely on color alone for selection, focus, errors, or status.
Don't require a CDN, frontend sidecar, or system JavaScript runtime in production; build and embed assets, never edit `apps/zero/internal/web/dist/` directly.
Don't round a corner on the site; `_root.css` keeps every Vocs radius at 0.
Don't give docs callouts, code blocks, or content a side stripe; the tint goes on all four sides.
Don't use coral beyond the logo mark, remote, and docs warnings.
Don't fill surfaces or set text in a tint; tints are borders and edges.
Don't replace panes with screenshots or SVG animation, or put RAM figures in them.
Don't hijack scroll, bind global keys, or present the landing as a walkthrough or a numbered sequence; rows are plain sections (decision 0106).
Don't set the uppercase label style above a headline as an eyebrow; it names chrome. A feature row's label is the lowercase mono feature name.
Don't let docs `pre` or inline `code` rules reach the landing; `_root.css` excludes `.landing`.
